dedupe_keys.name: diputacion foral de gipuzkoa road datasets

description: Diputación Foral de Gipuzkoa: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Diputación Foral de Gipuzkoa. Coverage: Diputación Foral de Gipuzkoa. The listing groups 21 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Habitantes de Hernani según sus Estudios - Por calles - Ayuntamiento d; Variaciones en el Padrón Municipal de Habitantes del Ayuntamiento de H; Habitantes de Hernani según su lugar de nacimiento - Por calles - Ayun; Multas de Hernani según su calificación (leve, grave o muy grave) - Po. Formats seen: CSV, JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/), as linked on the portal listing (https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/by/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
